title: Important Update: CBDT Releases FAQs for the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026
content:
# Important Update: CBDT Releases FAQs for the Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026

Ek important update hai! The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne **The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026** par comprehensive Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) release kiye hain. Yeh Bill Lok Sabha mein August 4, 2026 ko introduce kiya gaya hai.

These FAQs aim to make it easier for taxpayers to understand the significant changes proposed. The goal is to boost India's manufacturing sector, attract foreign investment, and simplify tax regulations.

Here are the key clarifications covered:

*   **Extended Tax Exemptions for Electronics Manufacturers:** Foreign companies providing capital goods, equipment, or tooling to Indian contract manufacturers for specified electronic goods will now get extended tax exemptions. The exemption period has been extended by another 10 years, up to Tax Year 2040-41, from the earlier sunset of 2030-31.
*   **Simplified Rules for Data Centers:** The Bill proposes simplified conditions for foreign companies procuring data center services from Indian facilities. This includes the removal of government notification requirements for both foreign companies and specified data centers, and allowing a leased ownership model for Indian data centers.
*   **New Exemptions for Foreign Diamond Mining Companies:** Foreign mining companies engaged in the sale of rough diamonds through Special Notified Zones (SNZs) in Mumbai and Surat will get new tax exemptions, applicable until March 31, 2041.
*   **Dividend Tax Relief for Business Trust Investors:** Investors in business trusts will receive dividend tax relief even if the Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) of that business trust opts for the new tax regime.
*   **Replacement of Ordinance and Other Amendments:** The Bill also proposes to amend the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, and replaces the Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026.
